title: Abstraction as a loose-coupling tool
answer: Abstraction promotes loose coupling when a consumer depends on a stable interface or abstract contract instead of a concrete implementation. Implementations can then be substituted, tested, or replaced with fewer changes to the consumer. Dependency injection commonly applies this principle by injecting a contract into a service while configuration decides which concrete implementation is used.
